source: Existing read-only XAUUSD export from Five Percent Online MT5, exported 2026-09-10; source SHA256 must match the prior export selection manifest
timeBasis: Broker-exported epoch labels; do not claim UTC or London/New York session alignment
dataQualityAmendmentBeforeResults: G4 prior-day levels require exactly92 continuous M15bars (23h), beginning00:00 or01:00 on exported clock. This matches the observed full-session structures. Short holiday days, incomplete boundaries and unexplained gaps are excluded as level sources. No evaluation results were computed before this amendment.
selection: Two fixed presets per family, 10 trials total. Rank development only by stress net / stress max candle-close drawdown (zero DD is ineligible), ties by preset ascending. Eligible: >=100 trades, net>0 and PF>=1.10 in both base and stress; no unpriced overnight positions. Freeze best eligible or highest-scoring failed candidate for diagnosis before validation. A failed development candidate can never be promoted by final results.
historicalScreen: Development eligible; validation AND final each >=100 trades, net>0, PF>=1.20, maximum drawdown <=8000 USD, maximum daily close-equity loss<=2000 USD; validation and final stress net>0, DD<=10000 and daily loss<=3000; no unpriced overnight holdings. Retrospective screen alone is not operational approval.
common: Closed M15 signal, next available continuous M15 open on same day; one position; entries 08:00<=hour<20:00 exported broker clock; exit at 20:45 open or first subsequent available open. No invented candles. Unexpected gaps prevent new entries; open risk uses observed gap prices. Wilder ATR14. Structural stop buffer0.25ATR, accept stop distance1..3ATR at signal and recheck actual entry. Target at least1R; two trades per day except range breakout one. Long and short symmetric.
riskReference: Fixed initial100000 floor90000; daily reference previous available close equity at broker day change. These are simulation assumptions pending program confirmation, not certified The5ers rules.

contract.rounding: Stop and target round outward to the tick. Recompute reward target using actual rounded stop distance at entry, then round target outward.

costCaveat: Fixed conservative scenarios, not verified historical executable spreads/fees. CSV spread is minimum within the candle and cannot price its own open. Actual contract costs, sessions and timezone require confirmation. Overnight positions are flagged unpriced; no invented zero swap.

families.name: Pullback de tendência
families.rule: H1 completed: close andEMA50 aboveEMA200, EMA50 rising3bars (opposite for short). M15 previousclose<=previousreferenceEMA, currentclose>EMA andopen. Stop min of two candles minus0.25ATR; reward2; hold16bars.

families.name: Rompimento da faixa inicial
families.rule: Freeze high/low of complete continuous 08:00 opening range of preset minutes. First close beyond edge+0.1ATR, previousclose inside range; entrybefore12:00. Stopmidrange; reward2; hold12bars; atmostoneentry/day.

Confirmationcandlebullish. Stopnewpivotlow minus0.25ATR; reward2; hold16bars. Short higherhigh,RSI5pointslower and>55. Never signalretroactively.

limitations: These periods were used by other research previously. No untouched-data claim, no five-strategy approval by counting variants. Portfolio coexistence, real-time forward tests and broker contract verification remain mandatory before manual-operation alerts. No live-order capability. One fixed batch; no result-guided retuning within this protocol.
